sql: with o as (select o.market_ticker t, o.created_at c, min(f.filled_at) fa from live_orders o join fills f on f.kalshi_order_id=o.kalshi_order_id where o.strategy='Fmmsell10' and o.action='buy' and o.created_at >= '2026-09-07T02:03:36Z' group by 1,2), tw as (select market_ticker t, pnl::numeric p from paper_trades where strategy='Fmmsell10_pt4' and pnl is not null and created_at >= '2026-09-07T02:03:36Z'), j as (select extract(epoch from (fa-c))/60 m, tw.p from o join tw using (t)) select case when m<3 then 'a<3m' when m<10 then 'b3-10m' when m<30 then 'c10-30m' when m<90 then 'd30-90m' when m<180 then 'e90-180m' else 'f180m+' end age, count(*) n, round(avg((p>0)::int)*100,1) win_pct, round(avg(p)*100,2) c_per, round(sum(p),2) usd from j group by 1 order by 1
